description:
The / command menu was previously limited to ~5 commands. It now has 15. The upstream has 21 builtin commands. 13 are still missing; 6 Elixir-only commands have no upstream equivalent.

**CURRENT ELIXIR (15 commands):**
clear, compact, config, continue, cost, export, help, import, login, model, scoped-models, sessions, settings, theme, tree

**UPSTREAM BUILTINS (`tmp/pi-mono/packages/coding-agent/src/core/slash-commands.ts`, 21 commands):**
settings, model, scoped-models, export, import, share, copy, name, session, changelog, hotkeys, fork, clone, tree, login, logout, new, compact, resume, reload, quit

**Missing from Elixir (13):**
| Command | Upstream description |
|---------|---------------------|
| `share` | Share session as a secret GitHub gist |
| `copy` | Copy last agent message to clipboard |
| `name` | Set session display name |
| `session` | Show session info and stats |
| `changelog` | Show changelog entries |
| `hotkeys` | Show all keyboard shortcuts |
| `fork` | Create a new fork from a previous user message |
| `clone` | Duplicate the current session at the current position |
| `logout` | Remove provider authentication |
| `new` | Start a new session |
| `resume` | Resume a different session |
| `reload` | Reload keybindings, extensions, skills, prompts, and themes |
| `quit` | Quit the app |

**Name mismatches:**
- Elixir `sessions` → upstream `resume` (browse and resume a session) and `session` (show current session stats)

**Elixir-only commands (no upstream builtin equivalent):**
- `help` — upstream equivalent is `/hotkeys`
- `clear` — upstream uses ctrl+c/ctrl+d keybindings instead
- `cost` — upstream shows cost in the footer
- `theme` — upstream uses `/settings` to switch themes
- `continue` — Elixir-specific agent continuation
- `config` — Elixir-specific config inspection

**Note:** The upstream dynamically appends skill commands (`skill:name`), prompt template commands, and extension commands on top of the builtins. Those are separate from this gap.
title: TUI-7: / command menu has different/limited commands
